title: Suricatoos — Remediation Payload: package_patch
description: The payload of a remediation job whose type is package_patch (ADR-0010): ONE vendor update to apply on a Windows endpoint, via the Windows Update Agent (wua) or winget. The job queue treats the payload as opaque; only the agent-side executor handler interprets it. Non-fabrication (ADR-0001): source/id/kb originate from the attested MSRC/WUA finding, never from AI.

source.description: engine that applies the update: Windows Update Agent or winget

id.description: WUA UpdateID (GUID) or winget package id — the thing the handler installs

kb.description: e.g. KB5041580 — the KB the update delivers; validation/audit (WUA)
